info.name: Real Estate CRM API
info.description:
# Real Estate CRM — API Collection

Fully token-based. Every protected endpoint expects:

```
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

## Getting started

1. Set the `baseUrl` variable (default `http://localhost:3000`).
2. Run **Auth → Login (Get Token)**. Its test script saves `token`, `tokenExpiresAt`
   and `userId` into the collection variables automatically.
3. Every other request inherits `Bearer {{token}}` from collection-level auth —
   you never need to paste the token by hand.

## Token lifetime

Tokens are valid for **exactly 1 day (86400 seconds)**. The expiry is absolute:
it is stamped at login and is never extended by activity. Once it passes, every
endpoint returns `401 TOKEN_EXPIRED` and the browser dashboard logs the user out.

Call **Auth → Me** at any time to see `secondsRemaining` on the current token.

## Error format

Every failure returns the same shape:

```json
{ "error": "Human readable message", "code": "MACHINE_CODE" }
```

| HTTP | code | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 400 | `VALIDATION_ERROR` | missing/invalid field, bad JSON, malformed id |
| 401 | `NO_TOKEN` | no Authorization header and no session cookie |
| 401 | `TOKEN_INVALID` | signature/format is wrong |
| 401 | `TOKEN_EXPIRED` | past the 1-day window — log in again |
| 401 | `INVALID_CREDENTIALS` | wrong email or password |
| 403 | `FORBIDDEN` | authenticated but lacking the role |
| 404 | `NOT_FOUND` | resource missing or owned by another company |
| 409 | `CONFLICT` | duplicate email |
| 500 | `INTERNAL_ERROR` | unexpected server fault |

The **Error Scenarios** folder demonstrates each one.
